title: Faster Stash navigation and reusable supplement routines

changes.title: Find supplies and compound inventory faster
changes.detail: Search Vial kits, Other forms and Supplies by compound or relevant inventory information without changing stock balances.

changes.title: Open Stash on Vial kits
changes.detail: A fresh visit through primary navigation now starts on Vial kits, while in-screen category switching and the post-save Other forms destination stay available.

changes.title: Reuse supplements from an earlier day
changes.detail: Use previous day copies the most recent earlier dated supplement selection into a draft; Check-In mood, symptoms, notes and prior logs remain unchanged.

changes.title: Save and manage supplement templates
changes.detail: Create, apply, rename and delete optional named supplement selections using guarded settings saves; templates never automatically save a daily check-in.

dataImpact: No destructive migration, historical record rewrite or automatic check-in save. The new optional settings.supplementTemplates field stores explicitly named selections through the exclusive writer, with readback validation; inventory history, backup files and existing dated logs are preserved. Stash search and chosen subcategory are transient UI state.
limitations: Generic preparation transfers and prepared nasal dose administration remain disabled; the separately enabled recorded nasal preparation workflow is unchanged.
Search and supplement templates are local to the current browser; account synchronization remains future work.
Synthetic calculator regression results do not establish clinical dosing or sterile preparation guidance.
Physical iPhone acceptance was user-reported as 7/7 PASS before the small Stash entrypoint correction; that specific correction requires updated acceptance before final release signoff.

history.title: Blend logging and iPhone refinements

changes.title: One blend-level dose record
changes.detail: New premixed blend doses are logged under the blend, preserving existing ingredient-level records.

changes.title: Blend vial lifecycle
changes.detail: Opened and finished blend vials are represented in Stash, with explicit tracking of associated blend metadata.

changes.title: Protocol and iPhone refinements
changes.detail: Updated Protocol phase and review input geometry for smaller screens.

history.dataImpact: No automatic migration. Existing constituent doses were preserved.

history.title: App experience, privacy and release foundations

changes.title: Backup and restore protection
changes.detail: Added restore previews, typed confirmation and recovery safeguards.

changes.title: Privacy and accessibility
changes.detail: Added Privacy & Data context, clearer navigation targets, focus and reduced-motion safeguards.

changes.title: Calculation safety checks
changes.detail: Added input, capacity and syringe-unit validation checks.

changes.title: What's New publication notices
changes.detail: Added published-release notices gated by deployment confirmation.

history.dataImpact: No automatic data migration. Backup restoration requires explicit confirmation.
